manual.title: Field Maintenance Manual
manual.customer: Prepared for Acme Defense Systems, Inc. under contract.

chapter.title: Introduction
chapter.para: The Line Replaceable Unit (LRU) is the core component. Each Line Replaceable Unit is tested with Built-In Test Equipment. The Line Replaceable Unit must be inspected before flight.
Built-In Test Equipment verifies the Line Replaceable Unit. Built-In Test Equipment reports faults to the operator.
The Auxiliary Power Unit (APU) supplies power. The Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) program applies. Later the RCM (Root Cause Methodology) is referenced, which is a conflict in this manual.
See page 42 for the maintenence schedule. Refer to page 7 for the wiring diagram.
This manual was also issued to Globex Corporation under a prior contract revision.
Support is provided by Acme Defense Systems Inc during the warranty period.
Page 3 of 12 appears in the footer. Page 4 of 12 follows on the next sheet.
